  300  class McpClient:
  301      """Streamable-HTTP MCP session: initialize -> initialized -> tools/call over keep-alive."""
  302  
  303      def __init__(self, url: str):
  304          self.url = url
  305          self.host, self.port_path = url[len("http://") :].split("/", 1)
  306          self.path = "/" + self.port_path
  307          self.conn: HTTPConnection | None = None
  308          self.session_id: str | None = None
  309          self._id = 0
  310  
  311      def _post(self, payload: dict) -> tuple[dict, object]:
  312          if self.conn is None:
  313              self.conn = HTTPConnection(self.host, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_S)
  314          headers = {
  315              "Content-Type": "application/json",
  316              "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
  317          }
  318          if self.session_id:
  319              headers["mcp-session-id"] = self.session_id
  320          body = json.dumps(payload)
  321          self.conn.request("POST", self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
  322          resp = self.conn.getresponse()
  323          raw = resp.read().decode()
  324          messages = self._parse_messages(raw)
  325          return messages, resp
  326  
  327      @staticmethod
  328      def _parse_messages(raw: str) -> list[dict]:
  329          raw = raw.strip()
  330          if raw.startswith("{"):
  331              return [json.loads(raw)]
  332          return [
  333              json.loads(line[len("data:") :].strip())
  334              for line in raw.splitlines()
  335              if line.startswith("data:")
  336          ]
  337  
  338      def _reconnect(self) -> None:
  339          if self.conn is not None:
  340              try:
  341                  self.conn.close()
  342              except OSError:
  343                  pass
  344          self.conn = None
  345  
  346      def _rpc(self, payload: dict) -> list[dict]:
  347          for attempt in (1, 2):
  348              try:
  349                  messages, _resp = self._post(payload)
  350                  return messages
  351              except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
  352                  if attempt == 2:
  353                      raise
  354                  self._reconnect()
  355          raise OSError("unreachable")
  356  
  357      def start(self) -> list[str]:
  358          """Initialize the session and return the tools/list catalog."""
  359          self._id = 0
  360          messages, resp = self._post(
  361              {
  362                  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  363                  "id": 1,
  364                  "method": "initialize",
  365                  "params": {
  366                      "protocolVersion": PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  367                      "capabilities": {},
  368                      "clientInfo": {"name": "rust-migration-baseline", "version": "0"},
  369                  },
  370              }
  371          )
  372          self.session_id = resp.getheader("mcp-session-id")
  373          if not self.session_id:
  374              raise RuntimeError("initialize carried no mcp-session-id")
  375          self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"})
  376          listing = self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"})
  377          return [t["name"] for t in listing[0]["result"]["tools"]]
  378  
  379      def call(self, tool: str, args: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  380          """One tools/call; returns (is_error, first_content_text_snippet)."""
  381          self._id += 1
  382          payload = {
  383              "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  384              "id": self._id,
  385              "method": "tools/call",
  386              "params": {"name": tool, "arguments": args},
  387          }
  388          messages = self._rpc(payload)
  389          msg = messages[0] if messages else {}
  390          if "error" in msg:
  391              return True, str(msg["error"])[:200]
  392          result = msg.get("result") or {}
  393          content = result.get("content") or []
  394          text = content[0].get("text", "") if content else ""
  395          return bool(result.get("isError")), text[:200]

   96      def grep(self, pattern: str, *, regex: bool = False) -> List[Path]:
   97          """One grep tool call: files (sorted) whose text matches ``pattern``."""
   98          self.calls += 1
   99          rx = re.compile(pattern) if regex else None
  100          hits: List[Path] = []
  101          for path in sorted(self.workspace.rglob("*.py")):
  102              try:
  103                  text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
  104              except OSError:
  105                  continue
  106              found = rx.search(text) if rx is not None else pattern in text
  107              if found:
  108                  hits.append(path)
  109          return hits

  111      def read(self, paths: Iterable[Path]) -> List[str]:
  112          """One tool call per not-yet-read file; returns the new file texts."""
  113          texts: List[str] = []
  114          for path in paths:
  115              if path in self._read:
  116                  continue
  117              self._read.add(path)
  118              self.calls += 1
  119              try:
  120                  text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
  121              except OSError:
  122                  continue
  123              self.chars += len(text)
  124              texts.append(text)

  293      # is both the context cost and the fit substrate, and the per-call
  294      # result cap does not apply.

  299      hits = sum(1 for name in targets if name in content)

  300  class McpClient:
  301      """Streamable-HTTP MCP session: initialize -> initialized -> tools/call over keep-alive."""
  302  
  303      def __init__(self, url: str):
  304          self.url = url
  305          self.host, self.port_path = url[len("http://") :].split("/", 1)
  306          self.path = "/" + self.port_path
  307          self.conn: HTTPConnection | None = None
  308          self.session_id: str | None = None
  309          self._id = 0
  310  
  311      def _post(self, payload: dict) -> tuple[dict, object]:
  312          if self.conn is None:
  313              self.conn = HTTPConnection(self.host, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_S)
  314          headers = {
  315              "Content-Type": "application/json",
  316              "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
  317          }
  318          if self.session_id:
  319              headers["mcp-session-id"] = self.session_id
  320          body = json.dumps(payload)
  321          self.conn.request("POST", self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
  322          resp = self.conn.getresponse()
  323          raw = resp.read().decode()
  324          messages = self._parse_messages(raw)
  325          return messages, resp
  326  
  327      @staticmethod
  328      def _parse_messages(raw: str) -> list[dict]:
  329          raw = raw.strip()
  330          if raw.startswith("{"):
  331              return [json.loads(raw)]
  332          return [
  333              json.loads(line[len("data:") :].strip())
  334              for line in raw.splitlines()
  335              if line.startswith("data:")
  336          ]
  337  
  338      def _reconnect(self) -> None:
  339          if self.conn is not None:
  340              try:
  341                  self.conn.close()
  342              except OSError:
  343                  pass
  344          self.conn = None
  345  
  346      def _rpc(self, payload: dict) -> list[dict]:
  347          for attempt in (1, 2):
  348              try:
  349                  messages, _resp = self._post(payload)
  350                  return messages
  351              except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
  352                  if attempt == 2:
  353                      raise
  354                  self._reconnect()
  355          raise OSError("unreachable")
  356  
  357      def start(self) -> list[str]:
  358          """Initialize the session and return the tools/list catalog."""
  359          self._id = 0
  360          messages, resp = self._post(
  361              {
  362                  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  363                  "id": 1,
  364                  "method": "initialize",
  365                  "params": {
  366                      "protocolVersion": PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  367                      "capabilities": {},
  368                      "clientInfo": {"name": "rust-migration-baseline", "version": "0"},
  369                  },
  370              }
  371          )
  372          self.session_id = resp.getheader("mcp-session-id")
  373          if not self.session_id:
  374              raise RuntimeError("initialize carried no mcp-session-id")
  375          self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"})
  376          listing = self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"})
  377          return [t["name"] for t in listing[0]["result"]["tools"]]
  378  
  379      def call(self, tool: str, args: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  380          """One tools/call; returns (is_error, first_content_text_snippet)."""
  381          self._id += 1
  382          payload = {
  383              "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  384              "id": self._id,
  385              "method": "tools/call",
  386              "params": {"name": tool, "arguments": args},
  387          }
  388          messages = self._rpc(payload)
  389          msg = messages[0] if messages else {}
  390          if "error" in msg:
  391              return True, str(msg["error"])[:200]
  392          result = msg.get("result") or {}
  393          content = result.get("content") or []
  394          text = content[0].get("text", "") if content else ""
  395          return bool(result.get("isError")), text[:200]

   88      """Deterministic grep and file-reading agent used as an evaluation baseline."""

   90      def __init__(self, workspace: str):
   91          self.workspace = Path(workspace)
   92          self.calls = 0

   95  
   96      def grep(self, pattern: str, *, regex: bool = False) -> List[Path]:
   97          """One grep tool call: files (sorted) whose text matches ``pattern``."""
   98          self.calls += 1
   99          rx = re.compile(pattern) if regex else None
  100          hits: List[Path] = []
  101          for path in sorted(self.workspace.rglob("*.py")):
  102              try:
  103                  text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
  104              except OSError:
  105                  continue
  106              found = rx.search(text) if rx is not None else pattern in text
  107              if found:
  108                  hits.append(path)
  109          return hits
  110  
  111      def read(self, paths: Iterable[Path]) -> List[str]:
  112          """One tool call per not-yet-read file; returns the new file texts."""
  113          texts: List[str] = []
  114          for path in paths:
  115              if path in self._read:
  116                  continue
  117              self._read.add(path)
  118              self.calls += 1
  119              try:
  120                  text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
  121              except OSError:
  122                  continue
  123              self.chars += len(text)
  124              texts.append(text)
  125          return texts

  128      def grep_pattern(names: Sequence[str]) -> str:
  129          """A single alternation pattern for a hop's names (bounded, sorted)."""
  130          bounded = sorted(set(names))[:_MAX_GREP_NAMES]
  131          return "|".join(re.escape(n) for n in bounded)

  284  def _cairn_pack_fit(conn, arm, t):
  285      from cairn.dashboard.tokenizer import active_tokenizer_mode
  286      from cairn.okf import OKFBundle
  287      from cairn.pack import build_pack

  289      bundle = OKFBundle(t["knowledge_root"])

  291      # One pack request counts as one call. The fitted item content is the
  292      # budget-bounded deliverable (the header only echoes the request), so it
  293      # is both the context cost and the fit substrate, and the per-call
  294      # result cap does not apply.
  295      arm.calls += 1
  296      content = "\n".join(item.text for item in result.items)
  297      arm.chars += len(content)
  298      targets = _fit_targets(t)
  299      hits = sum(1 for name in targets if name in content)
  300      return _FitResult(
  301          hits=hits, total=len(targets), tokenizer_mode=active_tokenizer_mode()
